snippet.title: Fatenames | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Two teams. One word. Every name holds a fate.

Fatenames is a free online word deduction party game for 4 to 30 players. Fateweavers see the key and give one-word clues. Seekers read the clue, talk it over and reveal their team's words, all while avoiding the eclipse.

Play free in your browser or on Windows: https://fatenames.com

Music: "Fatenames 2026 Theme" from the Fatenames 2026 soundtrack.
